question.problem:
$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}3x(1-{y}^{2}), & 0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le 1, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\,{f}_{X}(x)=\{\begin{aligned}2x, & 0\le x\le 1, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Let $X$ and $Y$  be continuous random variables. Their joint probability density function and the marginal probability density function of $X$ are shown above. Find the conditional variance $\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=1]$ given that the corresponding expected value is ${\mu }_{Y|1}=\frac{3}{8}.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=x] & =\text{E}[(Y-{\mu }_{Y|x})^{2}\,|\,X=x] \\  & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

where 

$$
\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)\,\text{d}y.
$$

Note that $\text{E}[Y\,|\,X=x]$ is a function of $x.$ 

The conditional density function of $Y$ given $X=x$ can be computed as 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x) & =\frac{f(x,y)}{{f}_{X}(x)} \\  & =\frac{3x(1-{y}^{2})}{2x} \\  & =\frac{3(1-{y}^{2})}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

where $0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le 1.$ Outside this domain, we have ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)=0.$

Notice that the factor of $x$ cancels out, leaving an expression that does not depend on $x.$ Therefore, substituting $x=1$ into the expression for ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)$ has no effect:

$$
{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)=\frac{3(1-{y}^{2})}{2}
$$

Then, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=1] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{y}^{2}\cdot \frac{3(1-{y}^{2})}{2}\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}({y}^{2}-{y}^{4})\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{2}[\frac{{y}^{3}}{3}-\frac{{y}^{5}}{5}]_{0}^{1} \\  & =\frac{3}{2}[(\frac{1}{3}-\frac{1}{5})-0] \\  & =\frac{1}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=1] & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=1]-{\mu }_{Y|1}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{5}-{(\frac{3}{8})}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{5}-\frac{9}{64} \\  & =\frac{19}{320}.\end{aligned}
$$
